newsitem.title: DUBAI: Horse Racing - Dubai names initial 1997 World Cup entry.
newsitem.headline: Horse Racing - Dubai names initial 1997 World Cup entry.

text.p: Helissio, Bijou d'Inde and Timarida are among 94 initial entries for the Dubai World Cup, billed as the world's richest horse race, to be run next March 29.

"We are all absolutely delighted by the response from the owners and trainers in six continents making their first entries for the 1997 Dubai World Cup," race committee chairman Michael Osborne said on Tuesday.
The inaugural running of the $4 million race this year saw U.S. wonder horse Cigar romp home to a spectacular victory on Dubai's mile-and-a-quarter sand track.

Bijou d'Inde and Even Top, who fought for the finish in the 2,000 Guineas alongside Mark of Esteem, head a British entry of 12 which also features Group 1 winners First Island, Luso and Sil Sila. Needle Gun, seventh behind Cigar in the first Dubai World Cup, has again been entered.
Helissio, winner of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, is the star of five French entries.
Classic winners Zagreb and Oscar Schindler feature among six Irish entries along with globe-trotting filly Timarida.
Louis Quatorze, winner of the Preakness Stakes, is rated the pick of 33 North American entries.

"We expect after the summer season in the southern hemisphere and winter racing in Florida and California that there will be further outstanding candidates to be entered at the second nomination stage in February," Osborne said.
The 14-strong field is due to be announced on February 12.
